answer: To blunt sybil swarms, lock a refundable bond on every new identity and release it only after independent peers attest real work. Fresh accounts start in a meadow of near-zero weight, so their first grades make only a faint ripple at settlement and a clone cluster cannot swing the score. Influence then climbs a slow spiral: consistent, independently checked mechanism answers raise weight gradually, while copied text burns the bond. Replica cost therefore outruns the influence those replicas can buy.
